note: Model IDs are exact; tiers and 'best for' are guidance. Pricing, context-window sizes and rate limits change frequently and are intentionally NOT listed here — always read them on the official page above. This file is the single source of truth: never hard-code model facts in prose, link to this table instead.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.bestFor: Anthropic's most capable widely released model, released September 1, 2026. For demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work, or when Opus 5 at higher effort still falls short on your evals. Same list price as Fable 5 with cache reads at a quarter of the cost. Three breaking changes vs Fable 5: forced tool_choice (any/tool) returns 400, thinking blocks are readable only by Fable 5.1 or newer, and editing earlier turns invalidates thinking blocks. Refuses in-band (HTTP 200, stop_reason: refusal); fallback targets are Opus 5 and Opus 4.8. 30-day retention (not ZDR-eligible unless expressly authorized by Anthropic); not on Priority Tier. (Supersedes Claude Fable 5, now a legacy model.)

models.name: Claude Mythos 5.1
models.bestFor: Same capabilities, specs and pricing as Fable 5.1, offered by invitation only to approved Project Glasswing participants (request access through your Anthropic, AWS, or Google Cloud account team). Does not run the conversation-binding check on thinking blocks. Customers without access should use Fable 5.1.

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.bestFor: Anthropic's recommended starting point for most workloads: complex agentic coding and enterprise work, 1M context, 128k output, a step-change improvement over Opus 4.8. Claude Code's default model on Max, Team Premium, Enterprise and the Anthropic API. (Supersedes Claude Opus 4.8, now a legacy model.)

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5
models.bestFor: The best combination of speed and intelligence, with a 1M-token context window — the balanced pick when speed and cost matter more than Opus-level depth. Claude Code's default model on Pro and Team Standard. (Supersedes Claude Sonnet 4.6, now a legacy model.)

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.bestFor: High-volume, latency-sensitive tasks: classification, extraction, routing, simple chat, and cheap sub-agents.

models.name: Claude Fable 5
models.bestFor: Legacy since September 1, 2026 (superseded by Fable 5.1) but still available. Multiday autonomous runs, first-shot on ambiguous specs, dense vision, sustained delegation to parallel subagents. GA June 9 2026. Refuses in-band (HTTP 200, stop_reason: refusal) — configure server-side or client-side fallback. Adaptive thinking only; raw thinking never returned. 30-day retention (NOT ZDR-eligible). Two reasons to stay on it for now: it supports forced tool_choice and Priority Tier (existing commitments only — new ones are no longer sold), which Fable 5.1 does not.

models.name: Claude Mythos 5
models.bestFor: Superseded by Mythos 5.1. Shares Fable 5's specs and pricing, offered separately for defensive cybersecurity workflows in Project Glasswing. Invitation-only, no self-serve sign-up. Customers without access should use Fable 5.1.
